ACCESSIBILITY PARTNER
501(C)(3) NONPROFIT

Creating an inclusive digital world for people with disabilities — Knowbility is a nonprofit organization based in Austin, TX, and an award-winning leader in accessible information technology since 1999.

⚖️ WHY DIGITAL ACCESSIBILITY MATTERS

The Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Title II requires state and local governments to make their digital services accessible to people with disabilities. In April 2024, the Department of Justice published final regulations mandating WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance for all web content and mobile applications, with compliance deadlines ranging from April 2027 to April 2028 depending on population size.

But compliance is just the baseline. Accessible documents benefit everyone — not just the 1 in 4 Americans living with a disability:

🌍 Broader Reach
Accessible content works on any device, any bandwidth, any assistive technology — reaching more users
🔍 Better SEO & Findability
Structured headings, alt text, and semantic HTML improve search ranking and content discovery
🧠 Cognitive Clarity
Clear navigation, consistent layouts, and plain language help all users — especially in high-cognitive-load contexts
⚡ Future-Proofing
WCAG-compliant content adapts to new devices, AI readers, and emerging assistive technologies

WCAG 2.2 AA isn't just about avoiding litigation — it's about building documents that are perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust for every human being.

🔍 AUDITING & TESTING
Expert WCAG audits and document remediation by certified professionals
♿ ACCESSWORKS
Real-world usability testing by people who use assistive technology daily
📄 DOCUMENT REMEDIATION
Specialist team for PDF and MS Office docs — full usability with assistive technology
🎓 TRAINING & ACCESSU
Annual conference and on-demand courses — beginner to advanced accessibility skills
